title: Real customization of oscar.model.AbstractOption not possible
author: printshirt
body_preview: Summary I have tried to customize and override oscar.model.AbstractOption to set up a T-shirt printing service on the basis of Django Oscar. Obviously a T-shirt printing service requires the upload OPTION of an image, that the customer wants to have printed on the shirt. title: Add per-variant ordering for product media
author: EugenBodanov
body_preview: ### Problem  Saleor allows assigning product media to variants, but the VariantMedia relation has no sort_order. As a result, ProductVariant.media has no guaranteed order, and content managers cannot configure a different media order for each variant. Example: ``` Product media:     A → B → C Variant Red:       B → A Variant Green:     C → A ```  ### Discord Discussion Link  https://discordapp.com...

title: Add translations for ProductMedia alt text
author: EugenBodanov
body_preview: ### Problem  Saleor supports translations for many catalog fields, including product names, descriptions, SEO fields, categories, collections, attributes, attribute values, and variants.
